create.name: Lynn McKenzie
create.bio:
Lynn McKenzie is an animal communicator and teacher of psychic development who has worked in the field for around thirty years. She created the Animal Energy Certification Training, a self-paced programme in which students learn intuitive communication with animals and an energy-based way of working with them, and she says she has taught well over 100,000 students in more than fifty countries. Her approach starts from the idea that animals are teachers and catalysts for our own spiritual growth, and that the ability to connect with them can be learned.

Alongside animal communication she teaches clairvoyance and psychic development through the chakras, with an on-demand Clairvoyance Mastery certification, a six-month Psychic Development Mentoring programme and shorter home-study audio courses, including one on animals in the afterlife and signs from animals in spirit. Her YouTube channel holds talks on animal reincarnation, soul contracts with animal companions and clairvoyance. She is the author of Bark, Neigh, Meow, published by Llewellyn, and of the illustrated guides Chakra Healing for Cats and Chakra Healing for Dogs.

books.title: Bark, Neigh, Meow: Awaken to the Transformative Wisdom of Your Companion Animal to Activate Your Soul's Highest Calling
books.author: Lynn McKenzie
books.description: Lynn McKenzie's book on the roles animals can play in our lives as teachers, guides and catalysts for spiritual growth. It mixes stories from her work with step-by-step exercises for connecting with a companion animal.

books.title: Chakra Healing for Dogs: Energy work for a happy and healthy canine friend
books.author: Lynn McKenzie
books.description: An illustrated guide to the chakra system as it applies to dogs. It shows owners simple energy practices for connecting with and caring for their dog.

books.title: Chakra Healing for Cats: Energy work for a happy and healthy feline friends
books.author: Lynn McKenzie
books.description: The companion guide for cat owners, introducing the chakras of cats in full colour. It offers simple energy practices for connecting with a cat.

courses.title: Clairvoyance Mastery Certification Training
courses.description: Ten on-demand classes on clairvoyant reading and energy clearing, with live question-and-answer calls and practice readings with classmates. Those who complete it can certify as a Clairvoyance Mastery practitioner.

courses.title: Psychic Development Mentoring
courses.description: A six-month programme with one lesson a month, energy activations and a personal chakra report, plus six recorded group coaching calls. It is designed for developing intuitive and psychic abilities step by step.

courses.title: Animals in the Afterlife: Exploring the Death, Dying & Spirit Life of our Animal Companions
courses.description: Six one-hour downloadable audio classes with transcripts and a study guide. They look at what animal companions may experience in dying and after death, signs from animals in spirit, and making memorials and ceremonies.

courses.title: The Divine Mission of Animals; Animal Communication Training Audio & Study Guide
courses.description: A 70-minute recorded animal communication training with a 21-page study guide. It covers the basics of receiving messages from animals and working with spirit guides.

courses.title: Activate Your Money Tree Training
courses.description: A 60-minute audio training using a clairvoyance-based visualisation focused on abundance and prosperity. It can be replayed at any time.

free_resources.title: Animal Lovers Free Training: Making The Heart Connection With Your Animal Companions
free_resources.description: A free online training in six steps for connecting with an animal, from grounding and quieting the mind to sending and receiving messages. It includes access to a 90-minute recorded masterclass with Lynn.

flags: Her Shift Network teacher photo looks quite different from her website and YouTube photos (different hair, possibly AI-generated), so only the YouTube avatar is used.
Reputation versus followers: she says she has taught over 100,000 (Shift page: 150,000) students in 52 countries, but public follower counts are small.

Her flagship Animal Energy Certification Training was left out because its sales page speaks of 'healing of serious health conditions' and 'medical miracles' in animals; a human may want to decide whether to list it with a neutral description.
Books Chakra Healing for Dogs and Chakra Healing for Cats were kept (no condition named; subtitle says 'happy and healthy'); borderline because of the word 'healing'.
Animal communication has no exact subject on the list; mediumship-spirits and chakra-healing are used as the closest fit.
Location not confirmed: an older interview places her in Sedona, Arizona, and readings are done at a distance, so availability is worldwide with no city.
left_out: Shift course Akashic Records & Animal Communication (theshiftnetwork.com/course/01LMcKenzie01_26): the page redirected to an empty test page on every try, so dates and price couldn't be checked.
Animal Energy Certification Training: sales page claims healing of serious health conditions and 'medical miracles'.
The Chakra Power Codes: page promises health improvements and 'HEALING' of physical imbalances (borderline).
Home-study courses Healing and Understanding Your Animal Companions Through the Chakras and Crystal Healing for Animals: 'better health, healing' framing for animals (borderline).
Talk to the Animals home-study course: its link now opens the Animals in the Afterlife page.
Money Manifestation Mastery masterclass (theprosperityalchemist.com): separate brand, not checked.
Videos 'Animal Communication & Healing Miracles', 'Animal Healing (With Short Demo)', Q&A sessions on 'healing', and short book clips under ~2 minutes.
Private readings and consultations (30 and 60 minutes): one-to-one.
